annotation.bound_parties_text: The text describes guidance intended to assist those involved in the development and operation of UAS, and does not state that it imposes obligations on any party.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: It is intended to assist those who are involved in all aspects of the development and operation of UAS.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: CAP 722 provides guidance and policy on the operation of unmanned aircraft systems within the UK.
